estimate_czOperator.statement:
(Lemma 10.0.3, blueprint form.) Let $a$ be a natural number with $4\le a$, and let $X$ be a metric space equipped with a doubling metric measure space structure $\mathrm{DoublingMeasure}(X, 2^a)$ (constant $\mathrm{defaultA}(a)=2^a$, viewed as a nonnegative real), i.e. $X$ is complete and locally compact, carries a measure $\mathrm{vol}$ (Lean's $\mathrm{volume}$) on a Borel $\sigma$-algebra, $\mathrm{vol}$ is locally finite, nonzero, and doubling with constant $2^a$: $\mathrm{vol}(B(x,2\rho))\le 2^a\,\mathrm{vol}(B(x,\rho))$ for all $x\in X$, $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, where $B(x,\rho)$ is the open ball. Write $C_K(a)=2^{a^3}$ and $V(x,y)=\mathrm{vol}(B(x,\mathrm{dist}(x,y)))$. Let $K:X\times X\to\mathbb{C}$ be a two-sided Calderón–Zygmund kernel with parameter $a$ ($\mathrm{IsTwoSidedKernel}\ a\ K$), meaning: (i) $K$ is measurable on $X\times X$; (ii) $|K(x,y)|\le C_K(a)/V(x,y)$ for all $x,y\in X$ (with $V$ as a real number); (iii) for all $x,y,y'\in X$ with $2\,\mathrm{dist}(y,y')\le\mathrm{dist}(x,y)$, $|K(x,y)-K(x,y')|\le\big(\mathrm{dist}(y,y')/\mathrm{dist}(x,y)\big)^{1/a}\,C_K(a)/V(x,y)$; (iv) for all $x,x',y\in X$ with $2\,\mathrm{dist}(x,x')\le\mathrm{dist}(x,y)$, $|K(x,y)-K(x',y)|\le\big(\mathrm{edist}(x,x')/\mathrm{edist}(x,y)\big)^{1/a}\,C_K(a)/V(x,y)$, computed in $[0,\infty]$. Let $r$ be a real number with $0<r$, and for $g:X\to\mathbb{C}$ and $x\in X$ let $T_r g(x)=\int_{X\setminus B(x,r)}K(x,y)\,g(y)\,d\mathrm{vol}(y)$ (the operator $\mathrm{czOperator}\ K\ r$; a Bochner integral). Let $f:X\to\mathbb{C}$ satisfy $\mathrm{BoundedFiniteSupport}\ f\ \mathrm{vol}$, i.e. $f\in L^\infty(\mathrm{vol})$ (a.e.-strongly measurable and essentially bounded) and $\mathrm{vol}(\{x: f(x)\neq 0\})<\infty$. Assume $\mathrm{HasBoundedStrongType}\ T_r\ 2\ 2\ \mathrm{vol}\ \mathrm{vol}\ C_{Ts}(a)$ with $C_{Ts}(a)=2^{a^3}$, i.e. for every $g:X\to\mathbb{C}$ that is a.e.-strongly measurable, essentially bounded and nonzero only on a set of finite $\mathrm{vol}$-measure, $T_r g$ is a.e.-strongly measurable and $\|T_r g\|_{L^2(\mathrm{vol})}\le C_{Ts}(a)\,\|g\|_{L^2(\mathrm{vol})}$. Let $\alpha\in[0,\infty]$. Then
$$\mathrm{vol}\{x\in X:\alpha<|T_r f(x)|\}\le\frac{C_{10.0.3}(a)}{\alpha}\,\|f\|_{L^1(\mathrm{vol})},$$
where the left side is $\mathrm{distribution}(T_r f,\alpha,\mathrm{vol})$, $C_{10.0.3}(a)=\mathrm{C10\_0\_3}(a)$ is a nonnegative real constant (per its docstring, the constant used in $\mathrm{czOperator\_weak\_1\_1}$), the $L^p$ norms are the extended-valued $\mathrm{eLpNorm}$, and the division and product are computed in $[0,\infty]$.
